title: Mari Cabrah in Albrecht’s pack
summary: Mari as a member of the king’s pack.

claims.text: Mari Cabrah, once a rival of Albrecht, now runs in King Jonas Albrecht’s pack, which makes Mari an envoy of sorts whenever travelling outside the king’s New England protectorate.

title: Margrave Konietzko and the Serbian front
summary: The Shadow Lord Margrave at war in the Balkans.

claims.text: Margrave Konietzko, a Shadow Lord, directs Garou efforts against the Wyrm’s forces in Serbia from the Sept of the Night Sky.

title: Sept of the Anvil-Klaiven
summary: A Get of Fenris sept in the far north, as one novel tells it.

claims.text: The Tribe Novel Silent Striders and Black Furies tells that the Sept of the Anvil-Klaiven is a Get of Fenris caern on harsh arctic ice in Scandinavia, led by Karin Jarlsdottir; only Garou who called the sept home lie in its graveyard, the Graves of the Hallowed Heroes, and its Gatekeeper opens moon bridges from the Hill of Lamentations.

title: Owl's Rest
summary: A lost caern of memory, as one novel tells it.

claims.text: The Tribe Novel Silent Striders and Black Furies tells that Owl's Rest was a small caern of memory found by the Roving Wind pack; warriors of the Sept of the Night Sky cleared the Weaver's growth from it and its pathstone tied it to stronger caerns, but the Wyrm's forces overran it.
